'''Zakl'n Gritch''' is one of [[K'ril Tsutsaroth]]'s bodyguards, along with [[Balfrug Kreeyath]] and [[Tstanon Karlak]]. He uses the [[Ranged]] style of the combat triangle in K'ril's chamber. His fearsome appearance and power over ice have earned him the nickname "Scourge of the Light", being a prominent soldier in [[Zamorak]]'s army.

He attacks by throwing large icicles, using them as javelins. He is considered to be a [[lesser demon]] for slayer assignments.

{{Average drop value}}

The drop table rolls out of 128 normally, however this is improved to 126 while tier 2 or higher [[luck]] is active. This slightly decreases the chance of 1300-1400 coins (in the [[#Other|Other]] section) from 66/128 to 64/126, while slightly improving the chance of everything else.

==Trivia==
* "Gritch" may be a reference to the children's holiday story "The Grinch". This is supported by the fact that his attacks are snow based, and "The Grinch" takes place in a snowy village.
* Before the graphical update, Zakl'n Gritch's attack consisted of him scooping snow from the floor, accumulating it into a snowball before hurling it at the target. He also resembled more of a lesser demon, being the only one of K'ril's bodyguards to lack wings.
** As a result of the graphical update, he essentially became an [[Alyaroth]] ([[greater demon]]), although he is still coded as a [[Byzroth]] (lesser demon). Despite this, he does not drop the lesser demon's [[Champion scroll (lesser demon)|champion scroll]].
* His [[Knowledge Base]] description was "For decades before his imprisonment in the ice, [[Temple Knight]] assassins attempted to slay 'The Gritch', due to its relentless reign of destruction upon their sacred lands. Each brave (yet foolish) attempt ended in failure, while the few that did return alive could only utter two words... "bloodshed" and "horror"."
